dpKa: the pre-registered value (crystals.json dpka, unchanged; the rows stay sorted by it).  dapsone: compilation value, no primary measurement located; carboxy: site value +1.03; brsalt: compilation value, no primary measurement located for the acid at 25 C; brcoc: compilation value, no primary measurement located for the acid at 25 C; sulfamate: off-axis (the sulfamic acid pKa (about 0.99, King & King 1952) is that of the zwitterion H3N+SO3- losing an N-H proton; the computed transfer puts the proton on O (the O-protonated tautomer H2N-SO2-OH, not measured), so dpka does not describe the computed neutral state (pka_note: outside the dpka analysis)); clsalt: compilation value, no primary measurement located for the acid at 25 C; perchlorate: alternative +17.0 [9.0, 19.0] (sources: crystals.json).

T1: periodic single site, one pair of the Z in the cell moved (f = 1/Z).  T2 PBE0 (est.) = T2(PBE) + [T1(PBE0) - T1(PBE)]: T2 (doubled cell) was run at PBE only, a true PBE0 T2 was not computed.  Sign undetermined: R4 - T1 and R4 - T2 est. differ in sign.
Cooperativity (gap map B1): N_vert - T1 as defined before its results (PLAN 19 Oct 9:40 PM item C, an addition to the pre-registration; T1 holds its one pair at the relaxed P4 geometry, N_vert moves only the H of every pair); vert.json's N_vert - T1v (both vertical); they differ by T1 - T1v, the relaxation of the one pair (PBE only).  Neither is a like-for-like test of the E_int/2 term (ladder cooperativity R4a_collective - R4a_single).  The cycle R1f -> R4 -> T1 -> N_vert -> R5 is closure.cycle_pbe0 / cycle_pbe in summary.json.
Margin: the lowest sampled point at delta > +0.1 A minus P0, where the profile has an other-side minimum (P4r present, interior PCHIP minimum at delta > +0.1 A); otherwise none, with the crossing energy at delta = 0 (not a state).  Hysteresis pairs reduced to the lower energy; the legacy value (lowest point at delta > 0) is margin_other_side_legacy in summary.json.
ZPE-corr. margin: bends perpendicular to D->A; >= x (deloc.): the P4r-frame ground state lies above its dividing point, so x is a lower bound (no localized other-state level).  p(other): the far-side population of the P0 frozen frame; (adiab.): no frozen frame (salts), the 1D DVR on the relaxed profile (adiabatic limit).

Margin (where there is an other-side P4r; the X-ray cell, the setting of the pre-registered profile): level spread (SCS-MP2, wB97X-D3(BJ)), delta(T), PBE / PBE50 anchors, in-field pair correction, relaxed cells, k and q mesh, def2-QZVP / def2-TZVPD pair correction, ZPE (frozen frame where both frames are localized; harmonic H D A and H only); a delocalized frame's ZPE (a bound) and other reference points (a definition) are listed apart, outside rss and the envelope.  Where margin() finds no other-side minimum at PBE0+MP2 (mppcp, nbaetpy) the same budget is that of P4r - P0, not a margin.  R5 at P4: the same at P4 with the vc cell shift.  dE_env: the PBE / PBE50 anchors, the cell and k mesh of R5, the basis of R1f (the pair corrections cancel).  Field and cluster rungs (REPEAT): the sc / gas charges, smearing radius and cutoff, the LR-mean collective estimator, the whole first shell / symmetric site.  The charge models and the shell size do not enter the periodic margin; every component not computed is None in summary.json (budget.*.none_reason).
Resolution: the margin where margin() finds an other-side state at PBE0+MP2, else R5 at P4; unresolved when the budget envelope of that quantity spans 0.  The pre-registered classes and counts are unchanged.
